memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer, Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands — four towns. Also from the tribe of Dan they received Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands — four towns. And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands — two towns. All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans. — Josh 21:20-26 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The pattern continues, tribe after tribe, town after town. Ephraim, Dan, half of Manasseh — each gives up some of its inheritance so that the Levites may have a place to live. Once again, a city of refuge, Shechem, is included, so that mercy is always near wherever the Levites settle.

There is a beautiful selflessness in this. Every tribe had to loosen its grip and share what it had received from God. No one tribe carried the burden alone, and no tribe was exempt. The care of God's servants was the shared responsibility of the whole nation.

This speaks to us about the family of God. We are not meant to live as isolated individuals, each guarding our own portion. We are called to share, to support those who teach us God's word, and to carry one another's needs (Gal 6:6, 6:2). The early church understood this — they held things loosely and made sure no one among them was in need (Acts 4:34-35).

When you give and share so that God's work goes forward, you are joining a very old pattern of grace. What God has given you is not only for you; it is meant to bless the wider family too.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you hold what God has given you with an open hand?
2. How can you support those who teach you God's word?
3. Is there a need in your church family you could help meet?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for the family of faith. Help me to share generously and to carry the needs of others, just as You have carried mine. Amen.
